'''Halari Takan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Mon Cala]]. She was a resistance leader on the planet, and was one of the Quarren representatives at the [[Dac Peace Conference]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
